title: BI: 3 Filipinos with military job offers to E. Europe stopped in Davao

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three Filipinos who were allegedly offered military work in Eastern Europe were intercepted at the Davao International Airport before their scheduled departure, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said on Monday. According to the BI, the three individuals were intercepted last Oct. 17 after questioning revealed a mismatch between their purpose of travel and the alleged intended destination and employment.
